questions.question_text: “Keṭlākne man ramāḍe chhe ne keṭlāk manne ramāḍe chhe.” Ā vāt kemī chhe?
questions.explanation: The Vato explicitly states, "Ā vāt nitye vichārvā jevī chhe."

questions.question_text: Sant kahe em karavu e _______ chhe ne mangamtu karavu e _______ chhe.
questions.explanation: The Vato states, "Ne sant kahe em karavu e nirguṇ chhe ne mangamtu karavu e saguṇ chhe."

questions.question_text: Ingoralama Shri Harie shuntī ājgnā āpī?
options: Amara janoe manmukhi na thavu pan agnama rahevu
questions.correct_answer: Amara janoe manmukhi na thavu pan agnama rahevu
questions.explanation: The text states: "Ingoralama Shri Harie kahyu: Amara janoe manmukhi na thavu pan agnama rahevu."

questions.question_text: Je kalyāṇne ichchhe tene shu karvu?
questions.explanation: The Vachanamrut states: "Je kalyāṇne ichchhe tene to man sāthe jarūr vair bāndhvu."

questions.question_text: Sar-Siddhi pramāṇe kyā dharmthī moṭo koī dharma nathī?
questions.explanation: The Sar-Siddhi states, "Pragaṭ Prabhunā vachan pāḷe, ethī moṭo koī dharma chhe."

questions.question_text: Vachanamrut Sārangaṇā 2 pramāṇe, _______ karīne to jīvprāṇīmātrane dukhavvā nahī.
questions.explanation: The Vachanamrut states, "Vachane karīne to jīvprāṇīmātrane dukhavvā nahī."

questions.question_text: Vachanamrut Sārangaṇā 2 pramāṇe, jīvprāṇīmātrane shunīne dukhavvā nahī?
questions.explanation: The Vachanamrut states, "Vachane karīne to jīvprāṇīmātrane dukhavvā nahī."

questions.question_text: Shunī dukhavvā nahī em Vachanamrut Sārangaṇā 2 maṅ kahevalū chhe?
questions.explanation: The Vachanamrut states, "Vachane karīne to jīvprāṇīmātrane dukhavvā nahī."

questions.question_text: Vachanamrut Sārangaṇā 2 pramāṇe, vachane karīne _______ nahī.
questions.explanation: The Vachanamrut states, "Vachane karīne to jīvprāṇīmātrane dukhavvā nahī."

questions.question_text: Kyā Vachanamrut maṅ em kahyu chhe ke vachane karīne to jīvprāṇīmātrane dukhavvā nahī?
questions.explanation: The text references Vach.Sā.2 for this statement.

questions.question_text: Bhagwānno bhakta hoy tene sauthī vishesh kyā avaguṇ bhāse?
questions.explanation: The Vachanamrut states, "Bhagwānno bhakta hoy tene to sauthī vishesh potāmā ja avaguṇ bhāse."

questions.question_text: Je bījāmā avaguṇ jue ane potāmā guṇ paraṭhe te satsangī chhe to paṇ shu chhe?
questions.explanation: The Vachanamrut states, "Ane je bījāmā avaguṇ jue ane potāmā guṇ paraṭhe te to satsangī chhe to paṇ ardho vimukh chhe."

questions.question_text: Swamini Vato pramāṇe, asevā te shu?
questions.explanation: The Vato states, "Te asevā te shu je avaguṇ levo."

questions.question_text: Amārī āgaḷ je koī Bhagwānnā bhaktanu ghasātu bole te to amne shu?
questions.explanation: The Vachanamrut states, "Amārī āgaḷ je koī Bhagwānnā bhaktanu ghasātu bole te to amne dīṭho ja game nahī."

questions.question_text: Jene Bhagwān ne Bhagwānnā bhaktano avaguṇ āvyo hoy tenā hṛudaymānthī kyārey shu ṭaḷe nahī?
questions.explanation: The Vachanamrut states, "...tem jene Bhagwān ne Bhagwānnā bhaktano avaguṇ āvyo hoy tenā hṛudaymānthī kyārey āsurī mati ṭaḷe nahī..."

questions.question_text: Jene guṇ grahaṇ karyāno swabhāv hoy teno satsangmā shu thāy chhe?
questions.explanation: The Vachanamrut states, "Jene guṇ grahaṇ karyāno swabhāv hoy teno ja satsangmā dṛuḍh pāyo thāy chhe."

questions.question_text: Bhagwānnā bhaktnā guṇ kahevā, temānthī jīv shu thaī jāy?
questions.explanation: The Swamini Vato states, "Bhagwānnā bhaktnā guṇ kahevā, temānthī jīv brahmarūp thaī jāy."

questions.question_text: Yogigita pramāṇe, kyā rasto na levo?
options: Avaguṇ koīno jevāno - jher pīvāno rasto
questions.correct_answer: Avaguṇ koīno jevāno - jher pīvāno rasto
questions.explanation: The Yogigita states, "Avaguṇ koīno jevāno - jher pīvāno rasto na levo."

questions.question_text: Kyā karanārāno koī divas chhūṭako thato nathī?
questions.explanation: The Vachanamrut states, "...paṇ Bhagwānnā bhaktanā drohnā karanārāno koī divas chhūṭako thato nathī."

questions.question_text: Bhagwānnā bhaktanī je sevā karavī te barobar koī _______ nathī ne Bhagwānnā bhaktano droh karavo te barobar koī _______ paṇ nathī.
questions.explanation: The Vachanamrut states, "Māṭe Bhagwānnā bhaktanī je sevā karavī te barobar koī puṇya nathī ne Bhagwānnā bhaktano droh karavo te barobar koī pāp paṇ nathī."
